id: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore (2022)

facts.text: Serve dessert when Newt turns up at Jacob's door in New York.
facts.why: Wikipedia and the IMDb plot summary have Jacob meeting Lally Hicks and joining Newt by portkey, and say Dumbledore recruited Jacob. Neither shows Newt arriving at Jacob's door. The wedding at Jacob's bakery is the New York scene, and it comes at the very end.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Jacob and Lally portkey in to join Newt.

vibe.verdict: A proper banquet card for the Bhutan election with the qilin, the manticore and the wedding cake, though the cue is shaky.
missing: The decoy suitcases that release multiplying pastries (Bhutan)
Lally's storm charm and the book portkey (Berlin)
Queenie leaving Grindelwald to come back to Jacob
The red and gold tie portkey to Hogwarts
Credence protected by Aberforth and Albus in the hall
ideas: Swap the note on 'Berlin pretzels' for 'The decoy suitcases. Open one and the pastries keep multiplying.'
Swap the note on 'Chicken momo dumplings' for 'The qilin bows once. Wait for it.'
Swap the note on 'Berlin schnitzel' for 'Lally's storm charm covers the getaway.'
Swap the cue to 'Serve dessert when Jacob and Lally portkey in to join Newt.'
